proof_body:
by
  intro R _ Z hc hi
  refine ⟨hi.genericPoint, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [hc.closure_eq] using (hi.isGenericPoint_genericPoint_closure).def
  · intro y hy
    have h1 : IsGenericPoint y Z := hy
    have h2 : IsGenericPoint hi.genericPoint Z := by
      simpa [hc.closure_eq] using hi.isGenericPoint_genericPoint_closure
    exact h1.eq h2
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)), IsClosed Z → IsIrreducible Z → ∃! x : PrimeSpectrum R, closure {x} = Z
